name: prytan
description: Your own memory of what you like and how you like things done, shared by every AI you use.

interface.longDescription: Prytan is your own memory of what you like and how you like things done, shared by every AI you use. Before each message it recalls what fits; as you talk it saves what you tell it about yourself: preferences, decisions, plans, interests and changes. You see, correct and delete all of it on your Prytan page. Nothing is saved unless you switched it on there.
capabilities: Recalls what you saved that fits the task
Saves preferences, decisions and plans as you talk
Everything is yours to see, correct and delete
interface.defaultPrompt: What do you remember about me?
